If you've spent the morning looking at the same paragraph, error message or unanswered email, start here. Choose the description closest to your problem, or try the short exercise below.

## Urgent concerns {#first-is-this-urgent-or-unsafe}

For immediate danger, contact local emergency services. For wellbeing, safety, conduct or privacy concerns, go straight to [Getting support](wellbeing-or-safety.qmd).

## Five-minute diagnostic

1. Write what you're trying to finish, such as a recruitment email or a results table.
2. Name what's holding it up. Do you need an answer, a skill, access, permission or help from someone?
3. Write what you know and what you still need to find out.
4. Choose one action you can take, or one specific question for the person who can help.
5. Set a date to review the result and try another route if needed.

::: {.decision-card}
“Work on thesis” is hard to start. “Compare the two sampling options and send my recommendation to my supervisor” tells you what to do.
:::

## Choose your pathway

- [My starting point or expectations are unclear](starting-or-expectations.qmd)
- [My topic or question is not defensible yet](topic-or-question.qmd)
- [I cannot stop searching or synthesise what I have](endless-searching.qmd)
- [I cannot choose a method](method-paralysis.qmd)
- [I am waiting for feedback, approval, access, equipment or data](waiting-or-blocked.qmd)
- [Recruitment, the study or the findings have failed](study-failure.qmd)
- [My analysis, code or files do not work](technical-failure.qmd)
- [I cannot start or stop revising the writing](writing-or-perfectionism.qmd)
- [There is a supervision, authorship or collaboration problem](relationship-or-authorship.qmd)
- [I am unsure whether the work is good enough](good-enough.qmd)
- [Workload, wellbeing, safety or conduct needs a different route](wellbeing-or-safety.qmd)

## What to take when asking for help

Explain what you're trying to do, what you've tried and what answer would help. Mention any deadline or risk. If the usual route hasn't worked, the [message template](../templates/escalation-message.qmd) can help you ask for further support.

## You are moving again when

You have an answer you can use or a specific task underway. Record the result and update any work that depends on it. If you're still waiting, keep the follow-up date in view.

## When the doctorate is difficult to live with

For isolation, exhaustion, funding worries, comparison with peers, difficult supervision, whether to continue and career uncertainty, start with [Isolation, money, exhaustion and whether to continue](life-during-a-phd.qmd).
